title.zh: OpenWrt 软路由科学出海全流程：PassWall / OpenClash 插件选型与旁路由透明网关配置
title.en: OpenWrt Router Proxying: PassWall vs. OpenClash & Side-Gateway Transparent Proxy Deployment

cluster.zh: 路由器固件与家庭网关

description.zh: 家庭与小型工作室软路由出海终极指南。深入对比 OpenWrt 平台两大神级插件 PassWall 与 OpenClash，详解旁路由（Side Gateway）单网口网络拓扑、DHCP 网关下发与全屋设备透明出海部署。
description.en: The definitive OpenWrt smart router deployment handbook. In-depth architectural comparison between PassWall and OpenClash, single-NIC side-gateway topology design, DHCP distribution, and whole-home transparent proxying.
